acts.text: Okay, here’s the TikTok hook text: Claude 4’s just quietly raised the bar on conversations… most people haven't even *seen* what it can do yet. Seriously, it’s a different level.

acts.label: CURIOSITY BUILD
acts.text: You’re probably scrolling, feeling overwhelmed by chatbots.  They’re clunky, repetitive, and frankly, useless.

acts.label: CURIOSITY BUILD (cont)
acts.text: Every AI assistant promises a revolution, but delivers the same frustrating limitations.  It’s exhausting, isn’t it?

acts.label: VALUE DELIVERY
acts.text: That’s where Claude 4 changes everything. It’s not just *better*; it’s fundamentally different.

acts.label: VALUE DELIVERY (cont)
acts.text: Claude 4 understands context at a level no other conversational AI achieves.  It remembers past interactions seamlessly.

acts.label: VALUE DELIVERY (cont)
acts.text: I’m talking nuanced debates, complex creative writing, and genuinely helpful problem-solving.

acts.label: VALUE DELIVERY (cont)
acts.text: Watch this: I asked Claude 4 to write a short story about a lonely robot discovering friendship.  It’s beautiful.

acts.label: EMOTIONAL PEAK
acts.text: Think about the possibilities.  No more wasted time wrestling with robotic responses.  Imagine truly collaborative brainstorming.

acts.label: EMOTIONAL PEAK (cont)
acts.text: It’s about unlocking your creative potential, accelerating your workflow, and feeling empowered.

acts.label: EMOTIONAL PEAK (cont)
acts.text: Suddenly, the future of AI feels exciting, doesn't it?

acts.label: CTA
acts.text: This is just the beginning.  Follow Daena for more on the AI revolution.

acts.label: CTA (cont)
acts.text: Or save this video – you won't want to miss this!
